# Hermes Sydney Transport

> Open-source Hermes Agent plugin for Sydney public transport, GTFS-Realtime route
> disruptions and vehicle tracking, stop accessibility, Complete GTFS timetables,
> live NSW road hazards, and historical NSW Roads Traffic Volume Counts. Python
> 3.12-3.14; MIT licensed; requires TFNSW_API_KEY.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport
Plugin name: sydney-transport
Python package: hermes_sydney_transport
Hermes entry point: hermes_agent.plugins / sydney-transport
Current version: 0.7.2

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, examples, limitations and development
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport/blob/main/docs/tool-reference.md): inputs, outputs and call sequences for all 22 tools
- [How it works](https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): request, Trip Planner, GTFS-Realtime, static accessibility/timetable, live hazards and road-count pipelines
- [Architecture](https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): normative dependency and extension contracts
- [Contributing](https://github.com/hongfeiyang/hermes-sydney-transport/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the only supported extension path and required checks

## Critical semantics

- Use stop search before departures or trip planning.
- Prefer departures.service_id for realtime tools.
- trip_code is not a GTFS trip ID; fallback resolution also requires stop_id.
- Route disruptions come from GTFS-Realtime Alerts v2 and preserve exact source feed provenance.
- Stop accessibility combines static facilities/lifts with optional current accessibility warnings.
- Route timetable uses Complete GTFS route/trip/stop IDs, which must not be reused as realtime identifiers.
- Missing estimates are unknown, not on time.
- Missing vehicle or occupancy data is unavailable, not stationary or empty.
- Live road hazards are current operational incidents and roadworks, not travel-time routing.
- Road traffic counts are historical observations, not live congestion.
- Realtime outputs expose freshness, join, prediction, inference and confidence data.
- Tool outputs are JSON strings in stable {ok,data|error} envelopes.

## Official upstreams

- Hermes plugins: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/developer-guide/plugins
- TfNSW developer documentation: https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/developers/documentation
- NSW Traffic Volume Counts API: https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/dataset/nsw-roads-traffic-volume-counts-api
